description: Shared type definitions for flight-related records in the at.adsb namespace.

contributor.description: A receiver that contributed data to a flight sighting.

did.description: DID of the contributing receiver account.

station.description: Strong reference to the contributor's at.adsb.receiver.station record.

sighting.description: Strong reference to the contributor's at.adsb.receiver.sighting record for this aircraft.

positionCount.description: Number of position reports this receiver contributed.

firstSeen.description: When this receiver first observed the aircraft.

lastSeen.description: When this receiver last observed the aircraft.

position.description: A single aircraft position report. Coordinates follow community.lexicon.location conventions: decimal degree strings, WGS84.

latitude.description: Decimal degrees north, WGS84. Negative for south.

longitude.description: Decimal degrees east, WGS84. Negative for west.

trackDeg.description: Track angle in degrees true north.

verticalRateFpm.description: Vertical rate in feet per minute. Negative is descending.

source.description: Decoder-level source type that produced this position fix.

trackSummary.description: Summary of a flight's path without the full position history. Coordinates follow community.lexicon.location conventions.

distanceNm.description: Great-circle distance between first and last observed positions, in nautical miles.
